units.rawText: Some things are better left unsaid, but I can feel from how you carry yourself that you've traversed fire and brimstone, walked the boundary between life and death.

units.rawText: Only someone who has witnessed the cruelties of war can be this well-versed in command as well as so keen in their understanding of life.

units.rawText: Some will say they are used to life and death, but that only lasts while death does not visit those closest to them. Even as a Doll, I have been granted a "heart" by the care of those around me…

units.rawText: And you grant me a "future" that I can look forward to. For the future that you would create, I shall follow you till the end.
